headline: Higher rates weigh on orders and margins, outlook trimmed
summary_short: Revenue was $864.5M on 2,442 deliveries, with net income of $12.6M, or $0.44 per share. Adjusted EPS was $1.01 and homebuilding gross margin was 15.0% after impairment charges.
summary_long: Adjusted homebuilding gross margin was 19.3%. Community count hit a record 343 and book value per share a record $90.61. Backlog was 1,106 homes worth $414.0M. Century repurchased $11.6M of stock and kept its $0.32 dividend. It bought HistoryMaker Homes on October 7 and now expects 2026 deliveries of 9,350-9,650 homes and home sales revenue of $3.3B-$3.4B.
confidence_notes: Year-ago comparatives were not read from the release excerpt, so deltas are omitted. Adjusted EPS and adjusted margin are non-GAAP.

drivers.explanation: Management cites a significant rise in interest rates, inflation and uncertainty that weighed on consumer confidence, especially first-time buyers; gross margin includes inventory impairment charges.
Margin of 15.0% includes inventory impairment; excluding impairment it was 17.3%.
CFO says increased mortgage rates affected orders and deliveries, leading to a lower full-year deliveries outlook.
